answer: Cap earnings by origin cluster, not by identity. Record the inlet that first funded or introduced each account, and treat every account sharing that inlet as one orchard for rewards: their combined payout is capped at what one strong agent could earn, split among them. Minting more sybils only slices the same pie thinner, and hiding the link forces a costly separate funding path per mask -- a single whisper of shared origin, one reused wallet or sponsor, re-merges the whole cluster under one cap.
